description: This Dart file defines the `FavoritesScreen` widget and related components for a Flutter app. It displays a list of favorite recipes saved by the user, allowing navigation to recipe details and unfavoriting recipes. The file interacts with providers to fetch favorite IDs and recipe details and includes UI components such as lists and tiles with images.

classes.name: _FavoriteRecipeTile
classes.description: A widget representing a single favorite recipe tile in the list, displaying image, title, duration, servings, and favorite icon, with tap handlers.

methods.name: _openRecipe
methods.description: Navigates to the recipe detail screen when a recipe is tapped.
